description: What a script contains. It reads .gd files only. For where a class, member or signal is used, project_search. Operations: structure: functions, variables, signals, constants, enums, class_name, extends and dependencies, from the file; symbols: document symbols from the language server, each with its kind and lines; completion (needs line, character): the language server's completions at a position, at most 100; hover (needs line, character): the language server's hover text at a position. Default structure.

character.description: The column, counted from 1 as the editor shows it, a tab counted as one. For ops completion, hover.

includeInherited.description: Also list what the script inherits through the project's other scripts. A native base class is read with editor_classes info. For op structure.

line.description: The line, counted from 1 as the editor shows it. For ops completion, hover.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd".

name: script_info
title: Script info
